# Operator Health Check — 2026-03-13 04:51 UTC

## Summary
- **Overall:** degraded
- **Disk:** OK — root filesystem at 69% used (452G / 662G)
- **RAM:** OK but notable pressure — 11.8 GB used, 1.6 GB free, 14.7 GB in buff/cache, 15.7 GB available
- **GPU:** busy but stable — RTX 4090 at 20.6 GB / 24.6 GB VRAM, 40C, 0% util at capture
- **PM2:** mostly online, but `whisper` is stopped
- **Docker:** multiple unhealthy/restarting containers
- **OpenClaw gateway:** responding on loopback, but supervisor state is inconsistent and service config needs cleanup

## PM2
Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
Issue: `whisper` status = stopped
Notable: `openclaw-gateway` uptime 1s with 2995 restarts at check time

## Docker
Healthy/Up: most containers
Issues:
- `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` — Restarting
- `lidaros-frontend-1` — Up but unhealthy
- `omiximo-email-automation` — Up but unhealthy

## Storage
- `/` on `/dev/sda1`: 69% used
- No filesystem above alert threshold

## Memory
- Total: 27.5 GB
- Used: 11.8 GB
- Free: 1.6 GB
- Available: 15.7 GB
- Swap: 0 MB configured

## GPU
- NVIDIA driver 580.126.09, CUDA 13.0
- RTX 4090 VRAM usage: 20550 MiB / 24564 MiB
- Main process: `VLLM::EngineCore` using ~20.5 GB

## OpenClaw Gateway
- Listening: `127.0.0.1:18789`
- RPC probe: OK
- Reported runtime: stopped/inactive via service state
- Service mode: systemd (disabled)
- Config warning: service file embeds `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` and is flagged as out of date/non-standard
- Recommendation from CLI: run `openclaw doctor` / `openclaw doctor --repair`; reinstall service with `openclaw gateway install --force` if systemd remains the intended supervisor

## Doctor Warnings
- WhatsApp group policy allowlist is enabled with no allowed senders configured
- Telegram group policy allowlist is enabled with no allowed senders configured
- Same allowlist issue exists for telegram accounts `stella-debts`, `nova`, and `default`
- Effect: all group messages for those routes will be silently dropped until allowlists are populated or policy is opened

## Recommended Next Actions
1. Repair `whisper` PM2 process or confirm it is intentionally disabled
2. Inspect restart/unhealthy logs for `langfuse_langfuse-web_1`, `lidaros-frontend-1`, and `omiximo-email-automation`
3. Normalize OpenClaw gateway supervision so only one intended control path is active and stable
4. Fix channel group allowlists if group intake is supposed to work
